Collectopus

How it works

1

Catch

Point your camera at something real — a pet, a car, a bird, food, a plant, a landmark — and tap Catch. Get close so one thing fills most of the frame. Every catch opens as a card pack.

2

Rarity & points

Common 1 · Uncommon 3 · Rare 10 · Epic 30 · Legendary 100. Rarity depends on the thing and on where you are: a car that's everywhere in one country can be rare in another. 1 in 50 cards is Shiny and gives double points.

3

Copy

Photos of screens, pictures, posters, prints and toys become grey Copy cards: they stay in your album but give 0 points and don't count for collections, sets, events or streaks.

4

Album & levels

Cards are grouped into collections (Dogs, Cats, Birds, Cars…). Catching the same thing again stacks the card (×2, ×3…); 5 of a kind level it up to Lv 2.

5

Streak

Catch at least one real thing every day to grow your 🔥 streak. Badges at 3, 7, 14, 30 and 100 days stay with you forever.

6

Events

A new event every week (Monday to Sunday). Catch what it asks for — say, 5 cats — to win a reward and climb the event leaderboard.

7

City Sets

Each city has its own set of things to find. Set items only count when you catch them in that city. We use approximate location and store only the city name.

8

Daily catches

5 catches a day for free, new ones at midnight your time. Invite a friend and you both get +10. Collectopus+ removes the daily limit.

9

Friends & leaderboards

Sign in with Google, share your invite link or code, and compare collections. Weekly leaderboards: friends, your city (if you turn it on) and the current event.

10

Your privacy

We don't catch people. If a person is the main subject, nothing is sent. Faces in the background are blurred on your phone before anything leaves it. We keep only the card picture, never the original photo, and only your city — never your exact location.
